reviewer: Kimi actual visual comparison of the exact native source, enlarged source page, complete unchanged 2048x2048 raw, targeted native raw face crop, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged user reference

remaining_reasons: The source-visible dark eyebrow group is not visibly restored above the green-ringed eyes; the native raw face crop shows a smooth brow area instead of distinct source eyebrow hair.

The lower yellow face continues into a conspicuously long tapered neck/chest section inside the open collar. Shorten and broaden this transition so the rounded chin meets the existing open collar without a long yellow funnel, while preserving the actual dark open V and clothing.
entries.positive_observation: The brown flight cap, forehead goggles, brown side fringe, neutral single mouth, forward bust composition and khaki clothing remain recognizable. The two beige collar sides are open rather than fastened closed. No separate spectacles or new beard was added. The full white/cyan views show an opaque working matte and solid clothing without interior holes; the RGB return has no alpha channel by design, so no source-alpha repair or production approval was performed.
entries.visible_limitations: The 42x46 source does not resolve fine goggle hardware or separate eye spectacles; those uncertainties are not rejection reasons. Rejection is for the clearly visible brow loss and elongated lower-head/neck geometry.
